# Answers

10. Write (c_1(1+x)+c_2x+c_3x^2=2+5x-x^2). Thus (oxed{[p]_{\mathcal B}=[2,3,-1]^T}).

12. A zero determinant collapses volume into a lower-dimensional set, so distinct inputs can map to the same output; therefore no inverse exists.

# Grading

Questions 1–10 are computational and worth 2 points each. Questions 11–12 are conceptual and worth 2 points each. Award 1 point for the correct method with an arithmetic or notation error, and 2 for a correct, explicit answer.
